hypothesis: Mixing early feature statistics during training improves joint classification on source-held field photos by reducing dependence on appearance cues common in the master data.
validation: Master validation selects each arm's best checkpoint using the existing macro-F1 rule. Score validation and the four fixed field development sources (Sheikh, Mduma, Pakistan, Pretoria) under the same D4 inference policy. Primary screen is the equally weighted mean of their joint-label macro-F1 scores, each over its represented classes with all 177 outputs eligible.
decision: Run the same seed and epoch budget in both arms. Mix spatial means and deviations after residual blocks 1 and 2, with random in-batch pairing. Preserve the labels, train-only learned preprocessing and deployment graph. An eligible result warrants a matched second seed and adequate-budget confirmation. No pilot qualifies for deployment. All test or confirmation sets remain outside the trial.
method_reference: Zhou et al., Domain Generalization with MixStyle, ICLR 2021, https://openreview.net/forum?id=6xHJ37MVxxp
